mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 1700 thousand units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces consumer wealth and future consumption expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicates a contraction in real economic activity, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both INDPRO < 117.0 and UNRATE > 5.3% are simultaneously true.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with a decline in CPIAUCSL over the past three months signals a tightening monetary policy cycle with disinflationary momentum, which increases the risk of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL declines over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL declines over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 345,000 million dollars combined with rising industrial production indicates strong underlying demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS > 345000 and INDPRO > 117.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a higher probability of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past six months signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% annualized.
